This '''[[Gender/Legends|female]]''' was the wife of former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bardan Jusik]], with whom she had numerous adopted sons, daughters and grandchildren. It was remarked by Jusik that she had died many years prior to when Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] came to him for advice on handling her [[Darth Caedus|brother]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
First mentioned in [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]]' [[2008]] novel, ''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]'', Traviss went on to state in her personal blog that had she continued writing for ''[[Star Wars]]'', Bardan Jusik's wife would have turned out to be the character of [[Arla Fett]], [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] sister first introduced in the [[Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons|''Jango Fett: Open Seasons'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series, and named by Traviss in her later book, ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''.<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page22/files/How_would_you_have_wrapped_u101.html|text=How would you have wrapped up Imperial Commando #2 if you hadn't pulled out of it?|author=Karen Traviss|archivedate=20150420003759}}</ref>
